scope: Fresh, supported Chromium host page, first import of the entire production core, without startApp/preloadApp/setupApp. Static call-graph inventory, not a timing attribution.

explicitCollectionAllocations.qualification: Derived by following top-level initializers, local factory calls and instantiated class fields. Excludes browser-engine internals and ordinary object/array/function allocations. Inherited registries can reduce counts when importing another core copy.

commonImportWork.behavior: Capture 12 native DOM/event method references; no document traversal or insertion
commonImportWork.difference: Jieshu also materializes one aggregate capabilities object.

commonImportWork.behavior: Check fetch support and bind window.fetch; no resource requests
commonImportWork.difference: Jieshu additionally binds fetch identity through a WeakMap and one context object at entry.ts:277.

commonImportWork.behavior: Initialize/reuse shared sandbox and event registries, publish window injection object
commonImportWork.difference: Jieshu additionally initializes/reuses unmount-depth and teardown registries, two Maps and two injection-object spreads.

commonImportWork.behavior: Construct public EventBus using Date.now string id; create event dictionary and register it
commonImportWork.difference: Jieshu dictionary has null prototype; Wujie uses ordinary object. Re-import id collision paths differ but do not occur on a fresh empty registry.

commonImportWork.behavior: Register one host popstate listener; do not run its route parsing callback during import
Define framework custom element once; on an empty page connected/disconnected callbacks are not invoked
commonImportWork.difference: Jieshu performs extra registry method checks and has more callback code; no iframe, shadow root, rendering or app mount during empty-page import.

commonImportWork.behavior: Create extra DOM-constructor name Set with 26 names, constant arrays/objects/regexes, class and function objects
commonImportWork.difference: Neither executes cross-realm constructor inspection during import.

jieshuExtraInitialization.name: AssetCache instances
jieshuExtraInitialization.work: 3 cache instances; each has 3 Maps, 2 WeakMaps, 1 WeakSet and 3 arrow-method closures, plus records pointer. No asset fetching, cache reconciliation, invalidation or parsing runs.
jieshuExtraInitialization.wujie: Only three plain cache record objects (entry.ts:40-42).

jieshuExtraInitialization.name: Fetch identity map
jieshuExtraInitialization.work: 1 WeakMap; add original and bound fetch keys sharing one context object.

jieshuExtraInitialization.name: Shared lifecycle registries
jieshuExtraInitialization.work: 2 extra Maps and window injection updates; lifecycle work itself is deferred.

jieshuExtraInitialization.name: Template lookup sets
jieshuExtraInitialization.work: 4 Sets containing 6 JS MIME types, 2 RCDATA tags, 5 raw-text tags and 14 void tags. No tokenizer/compiler execution.
jieshuExtraInitialization.wujie: Creates 21 regex literals in template.ts:3-23; matching is deferred.

jieshuExtraInitialization.name: Proxy property lookup sets
jieshuExtraInitialization.work: 4 document property Sets, one concat temporary array, 1 location keys Set. Also two resolver pipelines (proxy.ts:193,228): array/closure creation only; resolvers and Proxy traps are deferred.

jieshuExtraInitialization.name: DOM insertion handlers
jieshuExtraInitialization.work: 1 event-forwarder instance/arrow; 4 handler records/closures; HandlerPipeline instance creates 1 Map and loops over four handlers with has/set. Does not execute the handler bodies or touch any dynamic resource.

jieshuExtraInitialization.name: Script execution singleton
jieshuExtraInitialization.work: Random module-event prefix string; singleton instance and execute arrow closure. No script DOM creation, queue processing or network request.

jieshuExtraInitialization.name: Other empty weak containers
jieshuExtraInitialization.work: 7 WeakMaps and 1 WeakSet; population and associated runtime activity deferred.

jieshuExtraInitialization.name: Function binding caches
jieshuExtraInitialization.work: 3 WeakMaps versus Wujie 4 at utils.ts:36,49,59,83; Jieshu saves one here.

jieshuExtraInitialization.name: Symbols / idle scheduler
jieshuExtraInitialization.work: Two private Symbols, one global registry Symbol.for; binds native requestIdleCallback when present. Wujie reads callback without bind. Neither schedules an idle task during import.

deferredWork.name: Operation slot dictionary and cancellation promises
Sandbox lifecycle / event trackers / iframe / proxies
deferredWork.phase: first actual start/preload construction; not import. Class field collections do not allocate until an instance is constructed.

deferredWork.name: Window property enumeration, event overrides and instanceof patches
deferredWork.phase: iframe initialization. Neither Object.getOwnPropertyNames(window) nor patchInstanceofAcrossRealms is invoked at import; instanceof fallback WeakMap remains unallocated.

deferredWork.name: DOM effect patching, markup scanning, relative URLs, inline event compilation
deferredWork.phase: iframe initialization / later child DOM mutations; not import

deferredWork.name: HTML parser / URL parsing / resource fetch / script execution / template DOM
deferredWork.phase: API/lifecycle/event callbacks; function source contributes parse/preparse/code footprint at import, but bodies are not run.

interventionCandidates.name: AssetCache construction
interventionCandidates.proposal: In one diagnostic bundle gate only the three new AssetCache calls with a runtime window flag. Set flags before loading; preserve all class/method source and exact same bundle bytes in enabled/disabled samples. Do not invoke resource APIs in the disabled diagnostic case.
interventionCandidates.tests: If evaluate and post-GC heap drop but parse/compile does not, attribute to eager instances, not HTML parser complexity.

interventionCandidates.name: Lookup Set construction
interventionCandidates.proposal: Separate runtime gates for template lookup Sets and proxy property Sets, keeping Set arguments and all consumer code in the same bundle. This separates fixed lookup-table initialization from parser/proxy function volume.

interventionCandidates.name: Event listener and custom-element registration
interventionCandidates.proposal: Gate processAppForHrefJump and defineJieshuWebComponent separately for both frameworks. Retain their callback bodies and identical bundle. This checks common browser registration cost and any framework-specific difference.

interventionCandidates.name: Effect/script singleton construction
interventionCandidates.proposal: Gate the whole four-handler/insertion-pipeline group and the script-execution singleton independently. The hot resource handler bodies remain unchanged and are not invoked.

interventionCandidates.name: Other eager containers
interventionCandidates.proposal: If necessary group shared lifecycle registries and remaining empty weak containers. Treat this as diagnostic only: production lazy initialization must preserve cross-copy ownership and public API behavior.

caution: The larger total bundle and additional function bodies still cause transfer, parse/preparse and possibly compilation cost. Static inventory alone cannot rank their timing cost or establish that eager initialization explains the observed load gap. Do not describe deleting a module as an execution-only experiment.
